*Ronan wants a Wrack Boar tusk for his box, and the sea-glass his grandmother Agna has been saving for him. Bring him 10 tusks and the sea-glass.*

## Objectives

1. Bring 10 [Wrack Boar Tusk](../items/wrack_boar_tusk.md) (taken)
